title: Rivian R2交付启动 下半年放量成关键
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Just a really big moment, you know, R2 going out into the world.
segments.zh: 这确实是个重要时刻，R2正式亮相。

segments.en: What does that look like for the CFO? You know, you talk about 3,000 delivery gain in early July.
segments.zh: 对CFO来说这意味着什么？你提到7月初交付量增加了3000辆。

segments.en: What was the contribution of R2 to sales? What was it like for you towards the end of the quarter to say, this is tangibly what I have to show for R2's launch?
segments.zh: R2对销售的贡献如何？季度末时，你如何直观地展示R2上市带来的成果？

segments.en: Well, we're really excited about the opportunity to both introduce R2 to the world in June.
segments.zh: 我们非常兴奋能在6月向全球推出R2。

segments.en: So it's the start of our first external customer deliveries. Also the first opportunity for consumers to test drive the vehicle as well. And we're able to complete 57,000 demo drives over the course
segments.zh: 这是我们首批外部客户交付的开始，也是消费者首次有机会试驾。第二季度我们完成了5.7万次试驾。

segments.en: of the second quarter. And R2 is a key enabler and driver of the increase that we saw in our demo drive and traffic across each of our retail locations and spaces. And the reaction from the media has
segments.zh: R2是推动我们各零售点试驾量和客流增长的关键因素。媒体反响非常热烈。

segments.en: just been fantastic. And the same is true as we looked at the feedback that we're seeing from consumers who are getting behind the wheel experiencing it for themselves. And for someone like myself
segments.zh: 消费者亲自体验后的反馈同样出色。对我这样已在这里工作五年半的人来说，看到R2上路真是激动人心。

segments.en: that's been here for five and a half years now, just a really great moment to see R2 out into the wild
segments.zh: R2已经准备好在下半年扩大生产。

segments.en: and now ready in an imposition to scale up production over the second half of the year.
segments.zh: 克莱尔，你追踪这5.7万次试驾的转化率吗？有多少最终成为实际销售？

segments.en: Claire, do you track the conversion rate of those 57,000 demos how many end up being actual sales?
segments.zh: 克莱尔，你追踪那5.7万次试驾的转化率吗？其中有多少最终成为实际销售？
